key_insight: They formalize an end-to-end security proof for entanglement-based BB84 in Lean, removing hidden assumptions and making the cryptographic argument machine-checkable.
engineering_relevance: This provides a reproducible standard for quantum cryptography proofs and shows how formal methods can both verify security and help optimize finite-size key rates.
method: Formalized composable security of entanglement-based qubit BB84 against coherent attacks in Lean
Used the postselection technique to handle general attacks and finite block-size effects
Leveraged LLM-based autoformalization to build the proof and then reuse the pipeline for discovery
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a complete Lean formalization of the security theorem, with the same autoformalization pipeline also used to reduce the finite-size penalty on the key rate.
watch_item: Formal verification strengthens confidence, but the result still depends on the modeling choices, protocol encoding, and the finite-size assumptions used in the Lean specification.
paper_title: Quantum Cryptography and Autoformalization in Lean
